description: Land Title Settlement Department - Walahamulla, Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420050
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content is focused entirely on land property matters, falling clearly under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
